stage1.impression: A moody dusk interior with a purple horn-shaped lamp on a walnut sideboard; the glow on the plaster wall and the shade's shadow arch are the best things in it and it almost reads as a photograph. But the shade itself reads as a dark, opaque purple cone against a brighter wall rather than a lamp glowing through tinted acrylic, the left third is a crushed blue-black blob that is cut by the frame and does not read as a $20,000 loudspeaker, and the bottom of the frame is a black slatted band. Competent, atmospheric CG that is not yet a campaign page.

blocking_9: The shade must read as luminous tinted acrylic: its body brighter than or equal to the wall immediately beside it, not a dark silhouette (shade region [850,420,1100,540] lum_median >= wall [1250,420,1450,540]).
The loudspeaker at left must read as the same tinted acrylic object, not a blue-black void: left region crush_pct under 10 and its hue matching the lamp's purple rather than blue.
No large dead-black area: the sideboard slats [600,930,1600,1100] either lifted out of crush or cropped out of frame.
The lamp must visibly light its own sideboard top with a pool centred under the shade, with a crisp contact shadow under the foot.
No clipped hot spot on the opal sleeve, and no denoiser smear on the plaster at full size.

defects.what: Shade reads dark and opaque (lum_median 43.5) against the wall behind it (145 above, about 50-60 beside); the light-through-acrylic idea does not read.
Opal sleeve clips (8.6% clipped pixels) and reads as a flat white block.
Loudspeaker crushed (lum_median 4.9, crush_pct 30.6) and blue (b 38 vs r 8, g 0); unreadable, cut by the frame edge, wrong hue relative to the lamp.
Sideboard slat front crushed (crush_pct 51, lum_median 2.9): a black band across the bottom of the frame.
Sideboard top lit mostly by a pool left of the foot; the right of the foot falls into a dark wedge, and there is no clear light pool centred under the shade (lum_median 35).
Weak contact shadow under the foot; the foot sits rather than weighs.
Wall hot spot is salmon-pink (r 206, g 130, b 114) for a #EEE9E1 wall; with the magenta shade the whole frame becomes one pink-violet cast.
Plaster texture slightly smeared by the denoiser at full size; reads painted rather than photographed.
Hard black horizontal bar of the speaker's stand frame competes with the sideboard line and reads as a graphic element.

changes.problem: From rim height the camera sees only the shade's outer surface, which reads dark against the lit wall; the glowing inside of the shade, the reason for the shot, is hidden.

evidence.measured: shade lum_median 43.5 vs wall hot spot 144.8 and right wall 51

changes.expected: The camera sits about 10 cm below the shade's rim, so the lit underside of the shade and the light falling through the acrylic read as a glowing violet bell; the slat band shrinks at the bottom of the frame as the target rises.

changes.problem: The loudspeaker is crushed to near black and lit only by blue dusk, so it reads as a void and in a different colour from the lamp.

change.to: irradiance 0.30, color #E4D6E8, orbit azimuth -55 (from the window side, behind the speaker), elevation 20, distance 2.4, target [-0.55, 0.5, 1.0]

changes.expected: A soft rim and edge glow on the speaker's acrylic horn and frame; the speaker reads as a tinted acrylic object in the lamp's purple, still darker than the lamp.

changes.problem: The sideboard top gets little of the lamp's light; there is no pool centred under the shade.

evidence.measured: lum_median 35.2, p5 5.1; dark wedge right of the foot

changes.expected: A warm violet pool on the walnut under the shade, brightest at the foot and falling off to the shade's diameter; the underside of the shade brightens with it.

changes.problem: The opal sleeve clips and reads as a flat white block, and raising the bells (c3) would clip it more.
changes.expected: The sleeve glows warm white with a visible gradient, no clipped pixels.

changes.problem: The 2700 K light rendered at a 3800 K white balance turns the off-white wall salmon, and with the magenta shade the whole frame becomes one pink cast; the shade's tint has nothing neutral to read against.
changes.expected: The wall where the light hits it directly reads warm cream; the violet appears only where light passes through the acrylic, and the dusk window light goes slightly bluer for contrast.

changes.problem: The sideboard's slatted front is a crushed black band across the bottom sixth of the frame.

change.to: [1.25, 0.40, 0.0] (sideboard 7 cm forward so its top edge catches the lamp's pool and the fill), with the lamp moved with it: products.1.instances.0.position [0.36, 0.38, 0.68] to [0.36, 0.33, 0.68]

changes.expected: The front edge of the top catches light as a thin warm line and the slats pick up the fill; with c1, less of the front is in frame.

changes.problem: The denoiser smooths the plaster into a painted look and softens the acrylic edges.
changes.expected: Crisp plaster stipple and sharper shade rim at full size, with no blotching.

changes.problem: The foot's contact with the walnut is weak, so the lamp sits on the surface without weight.

evidence.measured: visual at 4x: faint ring, no dark occlusion line under the lower disc

change.to: 0.6795 (sink the foot 0.5 mm into the sideboard top, so there is no air gap)

changes.expected: A thin dark occlusion line where the lower disc meets the wood.

out_of_scope.request: Light the inside of the shade more evenly or open its throat less, so that less light escapes upward onto the wall above.
out_of_scope.why: Changes the lamp's parts and optics, which are fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speaker's stand frame less of a hard black bar.
out_of_scope.why: It is part of the loudspeaker; only its light and placement can change.
